Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: background illustration for a real responsive cybersecurity portfolio hero, not a screenshot or website mockup.
Input image: style reference only. Draw ONLY the illustrated hacker command center scene from the left hero of the reference, without reproducing any website UI, cards, logos, header, text, labels, stats or buttons.
Primary request: A wide cinematic, highly detailed semi-realistic graphic novel / concept illustration of a black hooded anonymous cybersecurity operator sitting at a workstation, viewed from behind and slightly to the left, facing a wall of multiple computer monitors. Black tactical jacket, face not visible. Operator's shoulders and head occupy center-right, monitor wall to right and upper center. Monitors show intricate teal terminal code marks, cyan world maps with red glowing nodes, dense technical interfaces, no readable text. Rich elaborate server room architecture and cables; beautiful cyan neon strip lighting across ceiling and monitor edges, restrained red rim lighting on hood, hands and desk; near-black scene.
Composition: wide landscape roughly 2:1. Leftmost 40% is an atmospheric dark server-room corridor with faint circuit details and shadow, purposefully negative space for real HTML headline overlay. Operator centered at 64% horizontal and 66% vertical. Hero scene fills frame to edges with no border. Crisp illustrative detail on figure and screens, dramatic contrasts, meticulous thin cyan accents, believable perspective, same visual impact as supplied reference. Dark enough to support interface overlays. Avoid skulls, masks facing camera, floating globes, matrix rain, bright blank monitors, watermarks. No text anywhere, no website typography, no collage.
